title: Before citing the wound-signalling path, check every step and flag

steps.expect: Six stage cards, stimulus → receptor → cascade → signal route → integration → response, with no gap; the receptor stage shows GLR3.3, GLR3.6, GLR3.2 and MSL10 as molecule nodes

steps.do: Read the hypothesis line and the flags
steps.expect: 'GLR as coincidence detector gated by MSL10 depolarisation: proposed ⚑' shown as proposed, not as an established step
Six references, each verified, each with its abstract verbatim and the line 'Verified means checked at abstract level, not full text'

must_not: any network request after load except clicked outbound links
a proposed mechanism drawn or worded as established
internal project terms (Cowork, todo, sweep)

title: Look at a candidate sense and the About framing

steps.do: In the hierarchy open 'Candidate senses (contested)' → magnetic field (PZ06)
steps.expect: Tier B3; the claim and the counter-evidence are both shown — the cryptochrome claim of Ahmad et al. and Harris et al.'s independent replication that found no consistent effect; the 'candidate sense — not established' badge
'Is this perception? Two views' with both positions cited ([n] links to Taiz et al. 2019 and Calvo et al. 2020) and the statement that the app does not answer the question

must_not: a candidate sense shown in the established branches
any sentence asserting that plants are conscious, feel pain, hear or learn

title: Learn the UV-B pathway and look at the receptor in 3D

steps.do: From the hierarchy open Light → UV-B (PL07)
steps.expect: UVR8 on the receptor stage; signal route and integration are dashed 'no verified source yet' cards; the header shows '2 gaps'

UniProt accession, AGI locus and FUNCTION text labelled 'UniProt, verbatim'; featured structure 4D9S with 'whole protein', 'experimental structure', and the curator reason (the rule's pick was a COP1 domain holding a UVR8 peptide)
A 3D view from the bundled file, with method and resolution, and no organism warning (Arabidopsis)

must_not: a structure fetched from the network at view time
a blank viewer box when WebGL is unavailable

title: See the chromophore a blue-light receptor carries

steps.expect: Featured 2Z6C with 'domain structure (129 of 996 residues)'; PHOT1 listed in 3 curated paths (PL03, PL05, PZ05)

steps.do: Open Flavin Mononucleotide from the small-molecule catalogue
steps.expect: Class 'chromophore', visible by default; bound in 2Z6C (PHOT1), 5SVV (ZTL), 6QQH (PHOT2) and 7WA4 (GI); a PubChem 3D conformer labelled as computed

must_not: a chromophore hidden by the default filter
a computed conformer presented as an experimental pose

title: Tell a predicted model from an experimental structure

steps.expect: Featured AlphaFold model with the 'Predicted model — not an experimental structure' badge, mean pLDDT, and the curator reason 'largely disordered; its PDB entries are short fragments bound to bacterial effectors'
Featured 6J5T (the resistosome) as 'whole protein', experimental

must_not: a predicted model without the predicted badge

title: Show shared receptors and a sense that sits in two branches

steps.expect: 13 molecules; phyB in 5 paths, CRY1 in 4; the caution that counts of paths are not centrality

steps.do: In the hierarchy look under Light and under Temperature
steps.expect: PL02 (phyB sensing warmth) listed in both, marked dual ⚑, opening the same path

must_not: a molecule labelled central, key hub, master regulator or most important

title: Find the rows whose evidence is not from Arabidopsis

steps.do: Evidence table: filter species to 'other species'
steps.expect: PS01, PS02, PZ02, PZ03 and PZ07 each with the 🌱 'not Arabidopsis' badge; PSI01 and PZ04 shown as mixed

steps.do: Open PS01 (rhizobial Nod factor) and its NFR5 sheet
steps.expect: Evidence species Lotus japonicus, Medicago truncatula, alfalfa and pea; NFR5 is a Lotus record with the 'UniProt record not reviewed' badge and the note 'Lotus japonicus structure; the Arabidopsis protein may differ'

must_not: an other-species row drawn as Arabidopsis evidence

title: Filter the evidence table and export

steps.expect: 33 rows
21 rows
A CSV of exactly the filtered rows, with the plant stage columns

must_not: an export that includes rows the filter hides

title: Sketch a drought and CO2 crossover and see which links are supported

steps.do: Open #/maps, create a map, add PYR1, SRK2E (OST1) and SLAC1 from the vocabulary and a free node 'my guard-cell model'
steps.expect: Vocabulary nodes link to their molecule sheets

steps.do: Link PYR1 → SRK2E, SRK2E → SLAC1, SLAC1 → my guard-cell model
steps.expect: The first two links are 'curated' (PD01; SRK2E → SLAC1 also PCD01); the third needs an override reason and is flagged 'Override: not backed by a curated path'
The report lists each link with its basis and the override reason

must_not: an override link drawn like a curated one

title: Find abscisic acid, alone and bound to its receptor

steps.expect: Abscisic Acid in the small-molecule catalogue, linked to PD01 and PD02
Bound in 3W9R (PYL9) and 3KDJ (ABI1); its own PubChem 3D conformer labelled computed
One sheet with two stereo forms ((-)-JA-L-Ile and (+)-7-iso-JA-L-Ile), linked to PW01 and PT04

must_not: two sheets for one compound's stereo forms

title: It looks like Greenhouse Explorer

steps.do: Open the home page in light, then dark
steps.expect: Greenhouse Explorer's palette, Fraunces / Source Sans 3 / JetBrains Mono type, the Greenhouse Explorer mark and the wordmark 'Plant Perception Pathways'; axe AA passes in both
Six stage colours from the Greenhouse tokens; the lens list has None and Shared hardware only (the pack has no proposed routes and no atlas)

a font or image fetched at runtime

title: The shared core works on a plant path (navigator, Focus, full screen, notepad, My maps)

steps.do: Open the navigator, search PD01 (drought), select it and press Focus
steps.expect: Focus reads in order stimulus → receptor (PYR1, PYL9, ABI1) → cascade → integration → response, left to right; PD01 has no signal route, so that stage is a dashed gap card; switching Layered (ELK) / Organic (fCoSE) keeps the selection (UI-24, UI-26)

steps.do: Click the cascade card, then the response card, in the stage inspector
steps.expect: Cascade shows its text and molecule chips SRK2E (OST1) and SLAC1; response 'stomatal closure' shows Plant Ontology PO:0002000 stomatal complex, labelled 'curator mapping' (UI-27)

steps.do: Enter full screen, hide controls and the info bar, then restore them
steps.expect: Each control does exactly what it says and the view does not jump (UI-20, UI-24)

steps.do: Add a note on the PD01 cascade card; reload the page
steps.expect: The note is still there, anchored to the card; the notepad link returns to it (UI-18)
A map with exactly the nodes and links shown in Focus, links marked curated with PD01 (UI-29)

must_not: the view jumping on selection
a note lost on reload
a saved map that differs from what was shown
